deviations.detail: A permanently deleted structure keeps its storage schema identity as a tombstone, so its id cannot be used again.
relation and file field values are opaque UUIDs without an existence check; purge restricts only recorded relation edges.

The sweep command and its schedule use illuminate/console, which the package already installs through its Illuminate dependencies but does not declare directly; declaring it would refresh every path-repository pin in composer.lock, which belongs to a separate lock refresh.

The console sweep calls PublicationLifecycle directly, as Auth's console commands call their services; each publication is recorded in the publication history under system:scheduler, while the operation-level audit event storage.publication.swept is emitted only when the sweep runs as a registry operation.
